content.text: Nambana imambu dokome Kamongo lakandape.
O Kamongo, nambana Anatu, emba kamame mupwa wakasa.
Kingi ketae pao kingi neta renge ingyuo karo pingi dopale emba ketako paleta karenge.
Emba kendali dokome komauna mendeke ingyuo pee piro karenge.
Yake doko komau anda ingyuo kawake lapala karene.
Ipwa ketae dorena embena anda pisi karenge kandale.
Kopa dupwa mena ose ipyuo penge uliuli ingyaro karo
porambaiye dokome papake ingyaro karena lao piso pengepya.
Porambaiye doko embena pii minyuo papingi ingyuo
yuu pele dupwa embena kendemande ingyuo pingipya.
Embame yuu dake puu rombo minyuo susa piinyi dokopa
walu walu laa naraŋa lao poraiyuo pyuokonda piinyi piro karamo.
Embame ipwa kota kameya dokome komau londe dopale inginyi pyambwapala
yuu kyau dupwa yambe pyaoreteepya.
Embame ipwa poraiyuo pyalana pyuo leene dokopa waiya lao kata nyingipya.
Embame pii dopa pinya lao pii ketae palyuo leene dokopa nakama aopa pengepya.
Yuu kyau dupwana lupyuo epo lama dorenaparaŋa lao
panda retakaminyi dokona pengepya.
Embame ipwa doko banya kata liti pyuo pona dokona pena lee dokome
dee yalo epo yuu dupwa yambe pyaa nangepya.
Embame yuu pau lama lama dupwana ipwa guu lanyi pyakamao
dee ipwa pona dupwa yuu kyau kuki dupwana piso lupyuo pena leepya.
Wii saape rae lenge dupwame nao
mena donge rae lenge dupwa ipwa nano pira dokopa narami lao pyakamii.
Ipwa repeta isa dupwana
yaka dupwa nakambana anda pipala pii lao lyuo karenge.
Embame yake panda piso yuu kyau dupwana apunda peeyo
isa yuu dake elya pyuo kalya pinyi nembelene.
Embame mena bulamakao dupwa isako doko narami lao andanyi pyambwakamingi.
Nenge dupwa wambu dupwana rangeme wara pyuo narami lao pyakamingi.
Rae maiyuo kararami lao ipwa waene maiyuo
gii mona paliramo karena lao olipi ipwange maiyuo
lopa nao kararami lao borete maiyuo pingipya.
Kamongo rangena isa sita yuu Lepanone dokona
wara piyamo dupwame apunda malu mandenge.
Yaka dupwame isa dupwana epo nakamana anda pingi.
Luu isa yale dupwana yaka kameya mende soko lenge nakamana anda pingi.
Mena meme rae lenge dupwa yuu kyau manda dupwana palenge.
Mena kuki saa yale dupwa yuu kana lapu lapu rondo dupwana yalu pyuo palenge.
Embame kana dokome ee kana minyinya lao wasiipya.
Neta anda paramo doko soo otenge.
Embame yuu kwuange gii reteenesa kwualyamo dokopa
mena suwa rae lenge dupwa neta kata nyuo epo pengepya.
Mena laene ene anda anda dupwa nuli nao nenge
Anatumi mailyamo dupwana pao dokopa pii porakai lao papingipya.
Neta pyakaelyamo dokopa nakamana anda palenge dupwana
kapu kyuo pao palyuo singipya.
Dokopa enakana wambu dupwa nakamana yulu pela penge.
Pao pyuo karo alemanji ingingi.
Kamongo, embame bange malu mee soo kaeyo wasiipya.
Apa pyuo mona palyakondali pipala wasiipi? lao suu pyao karo.
Isa yuu dake embame wasiinyi dupwameko simbwaro silyamo.
Kota pete ruŋupaŋu pyuo andake waso reteenesa
oo bangepe lee renge kuki epengepe dupwa
mendeme yaka lao sukusa parami ingya nalyamo.
Sipu duwpa ketae papyuo karenge dupwana koko
kau oma reeko mende Lipaitene lengedoko ipwa kota dokona male lao sinya lao wasii.
Nakama nenge yano pilyamo dokopa
embame jingi kandale jere lao masingi.
Embame nenge rapa rapa pyuo mailini dokopa
nakama nyuo nao sikya pingi.
Embame nakama yaki nyilini dokopa pakame kumuo karenge.
Ŋee ŋaape singi nyokonyapinyi dokopa nakama kumulyaminyi.
Kumapala yuu epeyami dokona dee range pao singi.
Dopa pipinyipape embame porambaiye maipinyi dokopa lee rao karaminyi.
Embame isa yuu dake letena renge enenge maingi.
Kamongona neta renge yulu doko sulu sinya.
Kamongo banya bange wasiyamo dupwana lao rae maiyuo karenale.
Baame isa yuu dake kandapyamo dokopainju ingyuo pyuku pyuku lala lala pelyamo.
Yuu kyau dupwa minyandapyamo dokopa isare kyau lao nyilyilyamo.
Namba Kamongo dokona lao kenane pyao karalu kararo.
Namba kararo yuu gii dusipana nambana Anatulakando kenane pyaro.
Nambana rae maingi renge doko baa keta epenge dokona
nambame kenane pyaro dokome baa epe sinyale.
Wambu yulu koo pingi dupwa isa yuu dakena koo keta palyuo penale.
Yulu koo pingi wambu dupwa dee pii nanale.
Nambana imambu dokome Kamongodoko lakandape.
Banya kingi doko minyalyuo lakando palena.
